purpose: Prevent project-memory holes, narrative drift, silent supersession loss, forgotten negative results, untracked archive requests and pseudoreplication by making every JANUS project an append-only event-sourced graph that HRain can traverse structurally and iNaiHR can expand associatively without promoting associations to evidence.
core_law: THE_CURRENT_PROJECT_STATE_MUST_BE_RECONSTRUCTABLE_FROM_APPEND_ONLY_EVENTS_AND_EXPLICIT_DEPENDENCIES. A SUMMARY IS A VIEW, NOT THE HISTORY.

HRain.forbidden: HRain structural adjacency must never be treated as external corroboration.

iNaiHR.promotion_rule: An iNaiHR candidate may become an evidence-bearing node only after D5 provenance binding to an independent source or measurement.

DemiHead.law: Agreement among JANUS faces can prioritize a test but cannot increase external evidence count.

required_views.PROJECT_ORIGIN: Why the project exists, original question, initial hypotheses, first physical discriminator and any semantic/project-only roots.
required_views.EVENT_LEDGER: Append-only chronological events. Never rewrite prior events to match current understanding.
required_views.DEPENDENCY_GRAPH: Machine-readable parent/child edges and selection dependencies.
required_views.CURRENT_AUTHORITY: Derived snapshot of what is currently admitted, blocked, waiting, negative, superseded and forbidden.
required_views.OPEN_GATES: Every unresolved measurement, archive, model or communication gate with exact next condition.
required_views.NEGATIVE_REGISTER: Immutable negative/failed results and what they specifically rule out.
required_views.EXTERNAL_CONTACT_LEDGER: Outbound request, recipient, exact scientific purpose, thread/message id if available, reply state, promised delivery and anti-duplication status.
required_views.SOURCE_MANIFEST: Files, datasets, emails, URLs, commits, hashes and custodians used by the project.
required_views.SELECTION_DEPENDENCY_REGISTER: Which coordinates, windows, frequencies, cases or samples were selected using upstream project information and therefore are not independent confirmation.
required_views.NEXT_ALLOWED_ACTIONS: Actions already authorized under current council/gates.
required_views.FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS: Actions that would violate preregistration, claim ceiling, waiting state, identity/hash gate or no-retarget rule.

project_storage_contract.append_only_rule: Historical records are immutable. Corrections are child events with CORRECTS or SUPERSEDES edges.
project_storage_contract.current_state_rule: CURRENT_AUTHORITY is regenerated from ledger events; it must never silently discard a negative, wait, block or superseded result.
project_storage_contract.cross_repo_rule: Linked canonical parents are referenced by repo+commit+path or immutable content hash; do not duplicate them as if newly discovered.

canonical_event_schema.event_type: ORIGIN | HYPOTHESIS | PREREG | MEASUREMENT | NEGATIVE | BLOCK | EXTERNAL_REQUEST | EXTERNAL_REPLY | FILE_RECEIPT | HASH | COUNCIL | CORRECTION | SUPERSESSION | CALIBRATION | CONTROL | SYNTHETIC | DECISION
canonical_event_schema.parents: zero or more prior event ids
canonical_event_schema.input_freeze: coordinates/windows/thresholds/sample ids/source ids known before result
canonical_event_schema.state_delta: which project lanes change and how
canonical_event_schema.selection_dependency_delta: whether this event can count as independent corroboration
canonical_event_schema.inaihr_projection: candidate associations with evidence_authority=0 unless separately sourced

mandatory_tests.name: ORPHAN_NODE
mandatory_tests.fail_if: non-origin event has no explicit parent or source lineage

mandatory_tests.name: MISSING_ORIGIN_CHAIN
mandatory_tests.fail_if: current narrative cannot trace back to PROJECT_ORIGIN

mandatory_tests.name: NEGATIVE_DROPPED
mandatory_tests.fail_if: a prior negative relevant to the active hypothesis is absent from CURRENT_AUTHORITY

mandatory_tests.name: SUPERSESSION_DRIFT
mandatory_tests.fail_if: superseded result is still described as current

mandatory_tests.name: BLOCKED_AS_NEGATIVE
mandatory_tests.fail_if: missing/unavailable data are described as scientific null

mandatory_tests.name: BLOCKED_AS_POSITIVE
mandatory_tests.fail_if: missing data are treated as suggestive support

mandatory_tests.name: ASSOCIATION_PROMOTED
mandatory_tests.fail_if: iNaiHR/semantic adjacency lacks independent provenance but is counted as evidence

mandatory_tests.name: INTERNAL_CONSENSUS_PSEUDOREPLICATION
mandatory_tests.fail_if: multiple JANUS faces are counted as independent sources

mandatory_tests.name: SELECTION_DEPENDENCY_PSEUDOREPLICATION
mandatory_tests.fail_if: dataset is independent but selected location/window/feature derives from the same upstream hypothesis and is counted as independent confirmation

mandatory_tests.name: EXTERNAL_REQUEST_UNTRACKED
mandatory_tests.fail_if: outbound archive/custodian request lacks lane, purpose, recipient and anti-duplication state

mandatory_tests.name: INBOUND_REPLY_UNFROZEN
mandatory_tests.fail_if: external reply changes knowledge but no immutable event records it

mandatory_tests.name: FILE_USED_BEFORE_IDENTITY_HASH
mandatory_tests.fail_if: delivered primary bytes are analyzed before identity verification and hashing

mandatory_tests.name: REQUEST_SCOPE_DRIFT
mandatory_tests.fail_if: requested artifact cannot answer the frozen scientific question or a proxy is silently substituted

mandatory_tests.name: LANE_MERGE_DRIFT
mandatory_tests.fail_if: calibration/control/exploratory lane is narrated as target-detection lane

mandatory_tests.name: WAITING_STATE_LOST
mandatory_tests.fail_if: custodian promised future action but lane is treated as closed or absent

mandatory_tests.name: NEW_STAGE_WITHOUT_GATE
mandatory_tests.fail_if: new physical/archive method begins without pre-stage gate/council when required

mandatory_tests.name: CLAIM_WITHOUT_SOURCE
mandatory_tests.fail_if: claim has no source authority or exceeds source-to-claim ceiling

mandatory_tests.name: HISTORICAL_CONTEXT_LOSS
mandatory_tests.fail_if: project reason-for-existence or the negative that caused a branch transition disappears from summaries

hole_detector.required_output: hole_detector_receipt with every test PASS/WARN/FAIL and exact repair edge

project_memory_packet.purpose: Minimum complete handoff for any future model/session/HRain/iNaiHR node before continuing a project.
project_memory_packet.rule: A new session must not infer project purpose from the latest file alone. It must load the origin chain plus current authority packet.

minimum_request_fields: scientific purpose phrased as provenance/reproducibility or measurement question
specific requested file classes or metadata
request for holding/access procedure if bytes cannot be released
no request for custodian interpretation of the target hypothesis
no speculative archaeological/exotic narrative unless directly necessary
no duplicate request while an existing thread is active

canonical_seal: JANUS REMEMBERS WHY A BRANCH EXISTS, WHAT FAILED BEFORE IT, WHAT SELECTED IT, WHO HOLDS THE NEXT BYTE, AND WHAT THE BYTE IS ALLOWED TO PROVE.
